text:
alex: deploy-bot just flagged a canary failure for inference-api during the change window. chart upgrade from v1.9.1 -> v1.10.0, canary readiness flapping. tagging @oncall-jay

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] CANARY FAILED: release=inference-api-canary namespace=prod-eu reason=readiness_probe_flapping 3/4 canary pods NotReady - auto-rollout aborted

oncall-jay: oncall here, looking. can someone share the failing logs? prefer pin or full rollback?

maria: quick summary: v1.10.0 included a CRD init + webhook that delays pod startup for ~20s. we didn't add the initContainer timeout bump. canary hit the probe window.

sre-ivy: pinning chart image/tag to the previous working image seems safer than full rollback (less churn across nodes). we can apply a manual pin to the helm release with reuse-values.

alex: if we're pinning, do this command from the ops bastion (will keep values same):
```bash
helm upgrade inference-api redwood/inference-api \
  --namespace prod --reuse-values \
  --set image.tag=1.9.1 \
  --atomic --wait
```

release-manager-lee: note: if we pin, update release notes and add a hotfix PR to revert the CRD/webhook change with tests. also record the decision in release-board. we might need to extend the change window by 30m to finish validation.

maria: I'll open the hotfix PR now: https://git.redwood/inference/inference-api/pulls/1234 (WIP) — branch fix/crd-init-timeout. including e2e that waits for webhook init. cc @eng-runtime

oncall-jay: starting manual pin now. i'll post logs if anything breaks. /exec helm-upgrade pinned

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual pin requested by oncall-jay. Applying chart lock: inference-api -> image.tag=1.9.1 in prod-eu

deploy-bot: [RESULT] Pin applied. Canary rollout stabilized: 4/4 Ready, all health checks passing. auto-rollout remains paused pending hotfix.

sre-ivy: good. can someone add a short rollback playbook entry: cause=webhook-init-timeout, mitigation=pin image.tag, followup=hotfix PR + revert change in next minor.

alex: added a one-liner to the runbook and linked the PR.

maria: PR #1234 created and assigned to @sre-ivy for review. I'll update release notes: "v1.10.0 withheld due to CRD webhook init timing; applied temporary pin to v1.9.1."

release-manager-lee: also add the change window note and who approved the pin (oncall-jay). We'll publish internal release note and notify customers on the scheduled digest.

oncall-jay: monitoring for 30m, then I'll close the change window early if stable. thanks all. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team. will follow up in incident-retrospective if we need a new preflight for CRD/webhook changes.

maria: FYI I scheduled a canary re-run in staging with longer probe time to validate the real fix.

oncall-jay: closing here in 30m unless new alerts show up.
